speaker_title: Address by Mr. Joko Widodo, President of the Republic of Indonesia

paragraphs.text: His Excellency President of the UN General Assembly,
paragraphs.raw_text: His Excellency President of the UN General Assembly,

paragraphs.text: His Excellency UN Secretary General,
paragraphs.raw_text: His Excellency UN Secretary General,

paragraphs.text: Distinguished Leaders of the Member Countries of the United Nations,
paragraphs.raw_text: Distinguished Leaders of the Member Countries of the United Nations,

paragraphs.text: This year…marks the 75th Anniversary of the United Nations.
paragraphs.raw_text: This year…marks the 75th Anniversary of the United Nations.

paragraphs.text: 75 years ago…the UN was born so that a great war ... the Second World War … will not happen again.
paragraphs.raw_text:
75 years ago…the UN was born so that a great war ... the Second World War … 
will not happen again.

paragraphs.text: 75 years ago … the UN was also established to create a world that is more peaceful, stable, and prosperous.
paragraphs.raw_text:
75 years ago … the UN was also established to create a world that is more 
peaceful, stable, and prosperous.

paragraphs.text: Because war will benefit no one.
paragraphs.raw_text: Because war will benefit no one.

paragraphs.text: There is no point of celebrating victory among ruins.
paragraphs.raw_text: There is no point of celebrating victory among ruins.

paragraphs.text: There is no point of becoming the largest economic power in the midst of a sinking world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
There is no point of becoming the largest economic power in the midst of a 
sinking world.

paragraphs.text: Mr. President,
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr. President,

paragraphs.text: In this 75th anniversary of the UN ... We must ask ourselves ... have we succeeded in creating the world that we dreamed of?
paragraphs.raw_text:
In this 75th anniversary of the UN ... We must ask ourselves ... have we 
succeeded in creating the world that we dreamed of?

paragraphs.text: I believe all of us will have the same answer … not yet.. Conflicts are still happening all over the world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
I believe all of us will have the same answer … not yet.. Conflicts are still 
happening all over the world.

paragraphs.text: Poverty and even hunger are still suffered by many.
paragraphs.raw_text: Poverty and even hunger are still suffered by many.

paragraphs.text: The principles of the UN Charter and international law are often neglected… including the respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The principles of the UN Charter and international law are often neglected… 
including the respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity.

paragraphs.text: All of us are concerned with this situation …
paragraphs.raw_text: All of us are concerned with this situation …

paragraphs.text: Our concern grew even deeper…in the midst of the Covid-19 Pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text: Our concern grew even deeper…in the midst of the Covid-19 Pandemic.

paragraphs.text: At a time when we ought to unite… and work together to tackle the pandemic…. what we see, instead, is one of deep division….and growing rivalries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
At a time when we ought to unite… and work together to tackle the pandemic….
what we see, instead, is one of deep division….and growing rivalries.

paragraphs.text: Whereas in fact…we must unite and always promote a win-win approach in building relations among state that is mutually beneficial.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Whereas in fact…we must unite and always promote a win-win approach in 
building relations among state that is mutually beneficial.

paragraphs.text: We all understand the negative impacts of the pandemic are tremendous… both on health … and the social economy.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We all understand the negative impacts of the pandemic are tremendous… 
both on health … and the social economy.

paragraphs.text: We are also aware that… the virus knows no boundaries across nations…
paragraphs.raw_text: We are also aware that… the virus knows no boundaries across nations…

paragraphs.text: No one is safe until everyone is…
paragraphs.raw_text: No one is safe until everyone is…

paragraphs.text: If division and rivalries continue to persist… then I am concerned that the pillars of stability and sustainable peace will crumble… or even destroyed.
paragraphs.raw_text:
If division and rivalries continue to persist… then I am concerned that the 
pillars of stability and sustainable peace will crumble… or even destroyed.

paragraphs.text: A world of peace…stable and prosperous becomes more and more difficult to attain.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A world of peace…stable and prosperous becomes more and more difficult 
to attain.

paragraphs.text: Excellencies,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies,

paragraphs.text: This year, Indonesia also celebrates the 75th anniversary of its independence.
paragraphs.raw_text: This year, Indonesia also celebrates the 75th anniversary of its independence.

paragraphs.text: It has always been our commitment… Indonesia will continuously contribute to world peace…as mandated by our constitution.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It has always been our commitment… Indonesia will continuously contribute 
to world peace…as mandated by our constitution.

paragraphs.text: Indonesia will continue to play a role as bridgebuilder… as part of the solution…
paragraphs.raw_text: Indonesia will continue to play a role as bridgebuilder… as part of the solution…

paragraphs.text: Consistently, this commitment is continuously upheld… including throughout Indonesia’s membership at the UN Security Council.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Consistently, this commitment is continuously upheld… including throughout 
Indonesia’s membership at the UN Security Council.

paragraphs.text: The spirit of cooperation will continue to be promoted by Indonesia … the spirit which provides mutual benefits to all parties…and leave no country behind.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The spirit of cooperation will continue to be promoted by Indonesia … the 
spirit which provides mutual benefits to all parties…and leave no country behind.

paragraphs.text: No one…no country should be left behind.
paragraphs.raw_text: No one…no country should be left behind.

paragraphs.text: The respect for equality… was also emphasized by Indonesia’s founding father… Soekarno… Bung Karno during the Asia-Africa Conference in Bandung in 1955… that gave birth to the Bandung Principles.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The respect for equality… was also emphasized by Indonesia’s founding 
father… Soekarno… Bung Karno during the Asia-Africa Conference in Bandung in 
1955… that gave birth to the Bandung Principles.

paragraphs.text: Until now…the Bandung Principles are still relevant… including in peaceful settlement of disputes... promotion of cooperation… and respect for international law.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Until now…the Bandung Principles are still relevant… including in peaceful 
settlement of disputes... promotion of cooperation… and respect for international law.

paragraphs.text: Palestine becomes the only country… attending the Bandung Conference… that until present has not enjoyed its independence.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Palestine becomes the only country… attending the Bandung Conference…
that until present has not enjoyed its independence.

paragraphs.text: Indonesia consistently supports Palestine... to gain its rights.
paragraphs.raw_text: Indonesia consistently supports Palestine... to gain its rights.

paragraphs.text: In our region, along with other ASEAN member countries, Indonesia continues to maintain South East Asia… as a peaceful, stable, and prosperous region.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In our region, along with other ASEAN member countries, Indonesia continues 
to maintain South East Asia… as a peaceful, stable, and prosperous region.

paragraphs.text: On its 53rd anniversary… on 8th of August 2020, ASEAN reaffirmed its commitment to continue maintaining peace and stability in the region.
paragraphs.raw_text:
On its 53rd anniversary… on 8th of August 2020, ASEAN reaffirmed its 
commitment to continue maintaining peace and stability in the region.

paragraphs.text: The same spirit of cooperation and peace was put forward by Indonesia to a wider region… the Indo-Pacific region…through the ASEAN Outlook on the Indo-Pacific.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The same spirit of cooperation and peace was put forward by Indonesia to 
a wider region… the Indo-Pacific region…through the ASEAN Outlook on the 
Indo-Pacific.

paragraphs.text: Excellencies,
paragraphs.raw_text: Excellencies,

paragraphs.text: Against this current global situation…allow me to convey a few thoughts.
paragraphs.raw_text: Against this current global situation…allow me to convey a few thoughts.

paragraphs.text: First… the UN should continue to improve itself… through reforms, revitalization…and efficiency.
paragraphs.raw_text:
First… the UN should continue to improve itself… through reforms, 
revitalization…and efficiency.

paragraphs.text: The UN needs to prove that multilateralism delivers…especially during the time of crisis...
paragraphs.raw_text:
The UN needs to prove that multilateralism delivers…especially during the 
time of crisis...

paragraphs.text: The UN needs to be more responsive and effective… in tackling global challenges.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The UN needs to be more responsive and effective… in tackling global 
challenges.

paragraphs.text: And all of us bear the responsibility to further strengthen the UN…
paragraphs.raw_text: And all of us bear the responsibility to further strengthen the UN…

paragraphs.text: So that the UN remains relevant and contributive… in keeping with the challenges of time.
paragraphs.raw_text:
So that the UN remains relevant and contributive… in keeping with the 
challenges of time.

paragraphs.text: The UN is not a mere building in the city of New York... rather it represents an ideal and shared commitment of all nations… to realize world peace and prosperity for our future generations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The UN is not a mere building in the city of New York... rather it represents an 
ideal and shared commitment of all nations… to realize world peace and prosperity 
for our future generations.

paragraphs.text: Indonesia has an unwavering faith in the United Nations and multilateralism.
paragraphs.raw_text: Indonesia has an unwavering faith in the United Nations and multilateralism.

paragraphs.text: Multilateralism is the only way that could guarantee equality. Second… collective global leadership has to be strengthened.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Multilateralism is the only way that could guarantee equality. Second… 
collective global leadership has to be strengthened.

paragraphs.text: We are all aware…that when it comes to relations among countries… in international relations… every country always protects their national interests.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We are all aware…that when it comes to relations among countries… in 
international relations… every country always protects their national interests.

paragraphs.text: However, we must not forget … that all of us have the responsibility to contribute… to be part of the solution…for peace, stability, and prosperity of the world..
paragraphs.raw_text:
However, we must not forget … that all of us have the responsibility to 
contribute… to be part of the solution…for peace, stability, and prosperity of 
the world..

paragraphs.text: This is where the UN should play a role… to strengthen collective global leadership.
paragraphs.raw_text:
This is where the UN should play a role… to strengthen collective 
global leadership.

paragraphs.text: The world needs the spirit of collaboration and a stronger global leadership… to create a better world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The world needs the spirit of collaboration and a stronger global leadership… 
to create a better world.

paragraphs.text: Third, cooperation in tackling COVID-19 must be strengthened…in terms of the health aspects…as well as the socio economic effects…
paragraphs.raw_text:
Third, cooperation in tackling COVID-19 must be strengthened…in terms of 
the health aspects…as well as the socio economic effects…

paragraphs.text: Vaccine will be the game changer in the war against pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text: Vaccine will be the game changer in the war against pandemic.

paragraphs.text: We need to work together to ensure… that all countries have equal access to a safe vaccine…with affordable price...
paragraphs.raw_text:
We need to work together to ensure… that all countries have equal access to a 
safe vaccine…with affordable price...

paragraphs.text: In the long term…the management of resilient global health system needs to be further improved.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In the long term…the management of resilient global health system needs to 
be further improved.

paragraphs.text: The resilience of global health system.... which is based on the national health resilience…will determine the future of our world.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The resilience of global health system.... which is based on the national health 
resilience…will determine the future of our world.

paragraphs.text: From the economic perspective…. revitalization of economic activities gradually needs to start …by tackling the limits of our global supply chain today.
paragraphs.raw_text:
From the economic perspective…. revitalization of economic activities 
gradually needs to start …by tackling the limits of our global supply chain today.

paragraphs.text: Revitalization of the economy must prioritize the health of all citizens of the world…
paragraphs.raw_text:
Revitalization of the economy must prioritize the health of all citizens of the 
world…

paragraphs.text: A healthy world…A productive world…needs to be our priority.
paragraphs.raw_text: A healthy world…A productive world…needs to be our priority.

paragraphs.text: All of these will only be achieved if all of us continue.. to work together…work together…and work together.
paragraphs.raw_text:
All of these will only be achieved if all of us continue.. to work together…work 
together…and work together.

paragraphs.text: Let us solidify our commitment and consistently carry out our commitment to work together.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Let us solidify our commitment and consistently carry out our commitment to 
work together.

paragraphs.text: That is all from me.
paragraphs.raw_text: That is all from me.

paragraphs.text: I thank you.
paragraphs.raw_text: I thank you.
